_tier: Tier A: map IDs, widths, original_life and the three bosses from v83 Map.wz / Mob.wz. Tier C: region, map order and pool rules (spec #449 C8, ticket #470, progression step 13), the 900 s duration and every pacing value, which copy Sleepywood's keyframe numbers (rate, max_alive, hp, speed), bursts, elites, exp_mult and hard_cap exactly (Sleepywood carries no post_duration_slope). Only the pools differ, and there is no opening_ramp: level_scale takes its place. Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: Leafre
_bosses: Tier C: owner schedule (Manon, Griffey, Leviathan; spec #449); hp_mult, dmg_mult and attack_dmg_mult are the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd (--step=13 --stage=leafre), not tuned. 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss. Canonical attacks, timing, stats and elements stay in Mob.wz. All bosses and reward choices must finish to clear.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #449. Each boss time is relative to map entry. Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own roster (Blue Kentaurus alone). Map 2 uses its v83 life list (Rexton, Green Cornian). Map 3 has an explicit pool, not its life list: the Cave of Light's only monsters are Skelegon 2 in Cave 9300076 and T-Skelegon in Cave 9300077, hideName instance copies with an EXP of 1500 (against 4500 and 4750 for the real mobs), which the spec's rule excludes. It takes the real Skelegon 8190003 (Lv110) and Skelosaurus 8190004 (Lv113) of the Nest of a Dead Dragon, the same Lv110-113 skeletons the cave's copies are, weighted 11 : 6 as Nest of a Dead Dragon 240040510 spawns them. Manon's and Griffey's native forests are 1530 x 90 strips and Leviathan's canyon is an 806 x 1347 vertical shaft, so they fight in the Kentaurus field, Dragon Forest II and the Cave of Light instead.

_level_scale: Tier C (#470, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=13 --stage=leafre, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (13 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is twenty-four effective levels harder. The draft raised no warning (the highest level, 80.85, is below the 131 where the reference curves go flat). Without it the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character.
